Directors and Officers Liability Insurance

In today’s complex regulatory and business environment, directors and officers face increasing scrutiny and legal exposure. A single decision—no matter how well-intentioned it is—can lead to lawsuits from shareholders, employees, regulators, or competitors.

This is why Directors & Officers (D&O) Liability Insurance is essential.

D&O Liability Insurance covers the directors and officers and their personal assets against liability arising from their management of an organization caused by covered Wrongful Acts, such as but not limited to: Breach of Duty, Breach of Trust, Neglect, Error, Misstatement, Misleading Statement, Omission, Breach of Warranty or Authority.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive D&O Liability Insurance that covers the following:
• Damages awarded or judgments entered
• Settlements negotiated with the insurer's consent
• Legal cost and expenses awarded vs. the insured but only in connection with a judgment which is covered in accordance with the policy terms

What is the information needed for Directors and Officers Liability Insurance?
• Company Name
• Nature of Business
• Location
• Names of Directors and Officers
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
